headline: Tullow Oil Lowers Free Cash Forecast Following $387 Million Tax Settlement
summary: Tullow Oil lowered its 2026 free cash flow forecast after reaching an agreement with Ghana's government to settle two tax disputes totaling $387 million.
why: Tullow Oil is an independent oil exploration and production company operating key offshore fields in Ghana.

impacts.name: Tullow Oil
impacts.why: Tax settlements reduce net cash flow guidance for future operating periods.
